Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows nine isolated effect cels, equal sizes with safe margins. Limited gold/amber/cream white palette, hard pixel clusters, stepped sharp outlines, no soft blur/antialias. Cells 0-5 are SIX sequential frames of the SAME tall flickering golden transformation aura about twice as tall as wide, open TRANSPARENT CENTER so the character body stays visible, golden flame contours change organically, upward energy tongues and bottom ring. Cells6 and7 are two small transformation radial flash stars with angular pixel spikes, centered white-gold. Cell8 sparse golden energy motes arranged upward, transparent between particles. No humanoid silhouette. No big opaque golden blob.
